description: Displays non-intrusive degradation banners when device conditions (low power, thermal pressure, model load failure) require reduced functionality. Auto-dismisses when conditions normalize. Per echo-memory-canvas-style §11.4.

states.description: Low power mode enabled. Banner shows battery warning + optional background task pause toggle.
Device thermal state .serious or above. Banner shows temperature warning.
Core ML model failed to load. Banner shows model error + retry button.

actions.description: User dismisses a banner (available for all degradation types)
User taps retry on model degradation banner
User toggles 'pause background tasks during low power' setting
User taps settings button to navigate to relevant settings section

journeys.description: Full lifecycle: normal → lowPower → thermal → modelDegraded → normal recovery
